pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of averaging down or scaling into losing positions within a 15-minute rolling window; add only in the direction of verified structural momentum with positive floating equity.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a 3-tier confirmation: Order Flow Imbalance > 65%, 1-minute RSI not exceeding extreme exhaustion (>80 or <20), and ATR volatility normalization before ticket execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing or partial profit harvesting once the position reaches +$12.00 to lock in gains and prevent erosion toward breakeven.
